levels.title: JSON 1 · Clean Syntax & Formatting Basics
levels.concept_capsule: Strict JSON (RFC 8259) requires double quotes on all keys and strings, forbids trailing commas, and uses 2-space indentation for clean diffs and reliable parsing.

tests.name: Double quotes only
tests.description: Replaces single quotes with double quotes

remedial_drills.title: Style & Doc Drill

keywords_glossary.role: Every property name and string value must use double quotes `"`. In production, single quotes break `JSON.parse`, REST APIs, and config loaders.
The final property before `}` must omit any comma. In production, stray trailing commas crash strict parsers during deployments and webhook ingestion.
Only strings, finite numbers, booleans (`true`/`false`), `null`, objects, and arrays are valid. In production, avoid `NaN` or `undefined`.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: Use 2 spaces per nesting level inside `{ ... }`.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Put `{` on line 1, one key-value pair per line, and `}` on its own closing line.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: One space after `:`, none before `:`, double quotes everywhere, and zero trailing commas.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: RFC 8259 forbids comments inside JSON; document contracts externally with JSON Schema or structured docs.

analogous_example.title: Valid billing worker configuration
analogous_example.why_it_works: Follows RFC 8259 strictly with double quotes, 2-space indentation, and no trailing comma on an independent payload.

levels.title: JSON 2 · Edge Cases & Documentation
levels.concept_capsule: In nested JSON payloads (objects inside arrays), each nesting level adds 2 spaces and every inner object must be free of hidden trailing commas.

remedial_drills.title: Syntax Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Fix the syntax error so the snippet parses cleanly.
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Remove the trailing comma inside the array.

remedial_drills.title: Edge-Case Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Add the defensive guard to prevent runtime failures.
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Escape literal newlines inside JSON strings as `\n`.

remedial_drills.title: Style & Doc Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Apply the official formatting and documentation standard.
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Format with 2 spaces per nesting level.

keywords_glossary.role: Array of objects representing structured collections. In production, it models webhook batches, routes, or channel configs.
Separate sibling objects with `},`, never after the last inner property or final object before `]`. In production, this avoids subtle HTTP 400 parse errors.
Level 1 = 2 spaces, array item `{` = 4 spaces, inner properties = 6 spaces. In production, mismatched braces jump out immediately in diffs.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: Add 2 spaces for each open `{` or `[` (2 → 4 → 6 spaces for nested objects).
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Place each array object on new lines and align closing `}` and `]` with their opening level.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Ensure zero `,}` or `,]` sequences exist at any depth.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: Keep key naming consistent (`camelCase` or `snake_case`) and document the contract with JSON Schema.

analogous_example.title: Nested notification channels manifest
analogous_example.why_it_works: Demonstrates 2/4/6-space nesting, clean `},` separation, and zero trailing commas in a separate domain.
